The counters are the 82 dwords from 0x3fde4e (their sum equals the total in the dump, 3203448; e2m 1125 DC_Mon_Long_Term_Map resolves 2 bytes earlier, to 0x3fde4c). When the monitor is off or the engine is stopped it only acts on duty_cycle_monitor_map_reset_pending_flag (e2m 111F +3 DC_Mon_Map_Reset): it zeroes the total, the counters and the percent words and clears the flag. (was cm848_outputs2_periodic)

RAM refresh initializer: fills the one block descriptor of the refresh table (12-byte entries at 0x3fd2c4: RAM start sensor_channel_cal_block_start 0x3feed0, RAM end sensor_channel_ram_start 0x40a046, source ROM 0x64aea), points the current-descriptor cursor at 0x3fd2d0 at it, restarts the compare cursors (sensor_cal_ram_write_ptr = the RAM start, sensor_cal_rom_read_ptr = the ROM source), clears sensor_cal_write_dirty_flag, sets diagnostic_session_state = ACTIVE (e2m 10C7 +0 RAM_Refresh_Enable = 1), sensor_validation_result = 1 (e2m 10C7 +2 Powerdown_Refresh_Enable) and sensor_cal_session_state_prev = 1. Called only by cm848_initProtectionModule (the refresh pass) on its first pass and whenever the refresh has just been enabled again (sensor_cal_session_state_prev = 0 while diagnostic_session_state is not INACTIVE). (was uds_session_state_init)

RAM refresh pass - the body of the background loop of cm848_applicationMain and cm848_restartApplicationWithoutReset (do { ... } while (power_down_start_flag == 0)). While diagnostic_session_state is not INACTIVE (e2m 10C7 +0 RAM_Refresh_Enable = 1) each call compares up to 100 bytes (50 words) of the current block of the refresh table with its source and rewrites every RAM word that differs (sensor_cal_write_dirty_flag = 1). The one block is the sensor channel calibration block (sensor_channel_cal_block_start .. sensor_channel_ram_start, 0x3feed0-0x40a046) against ROM 0x64aea (the EEPROM mirror ends before it, at 0x3feec1); the EEPROM side of the refresh is the periodic mirror reload (cm848_periodicTaskSet_protection2 -> cm848_startEepromBlockRead, 30 words per read, copied in by cm848_onEepromBlockRead only while diagnostic_session_state is not INACTIVE). When a cycle through all blocks ends it sets fault bit 0 (fault_detected_bits_0_to_15 |= 1, e2m 1036 +0 RAM_Image_Word_Error 'RAM refresh generated error'; fault 0 -> ROM slot table 0x5985a -> obd_dtc_code_table = P0606) if any word was rewritten during the cycle, else clears it; it counts cycles in sensor_cal_ring_cycle_count. It calls uds_session_state_init when the refresh has just been enabled (sensor_cal_session_state_prev = 0) and clears fault bit 0 on that edge. It does nothing while the refresh is disabled (development mode). (was cm848_initProtectionModule)

evidence: cruise_resume_active_flag (e2m 117D +60 Cruise_Resume_Status 'Status of the Cruise Control Resume') as it was at the end of the previous pass: cm848_arbitrateGovernedFueling stores it at the end of every pass (sth @ 0x406b8) and reads it back in the next one (lhz @ 0x4064c). In a first pass of cruise control (9) or vehicle speed limit (10), when the previous pass was neither of them and this word is 0, it calls protectionRampRateControl. The dword at 0x3fb526 is two words: governor_fuel_demand_working_mode_prev and this one. No e2m record at this address.

Saved copy of cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_maximum (e2m 81AE +C CBD_Fueling_Trim_Maximum, the upper limit of the learned cylinder trims) while the cylinder contribution test runs: cm848_runCylinderContributionTest stores it (sth) when the test starts and loads the service maximum cylinder_balance_service_fueling_trim_maximum (e2m 8C73 +4) in its place, then writes it back (lha) once cylinder_contribution_test_status is no longer 1. Signed word. Its twin is cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_minimum_snapshot at 0x3fb5a6; the six saved trims before them (0x3fb598) are unnamed. No e2m record at this address.

Saved copy of cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_minimum (e2m 81AE +E CBD_Fueling_Trim_Minimum, the lower limit of the learned cylinder trims) while the cylinder contribution test runs: cm848_runCylinderContributionTest stores it (sth) when the test starts and loads the service minimum cylinder_balance_service_fueling_trim_minimum (e2m 8C73 +6) in its place, then writes it back (lha) once cylinder_contribution_test_status is no longer 1. Address at which the current data collector fill stops (no e2m record at this address in the 11.46.06 table). cm848_phase_groupB_calculation (the collector pass) sets it when it starts a fill: one past the buffer end (buffer start + 0x8000 - the unused remainder) while it records before the trigger - never reached, the write pointer wraps at the buffer end first -, buffer start + table entries x (data_collector_sample_capacity >> 1) - 1 for stop mode 1 (diag_dm1_fill_mode_config, e2m Collector_Stop_Mode), the buffer end data_collector_buffer_end_address for stop mode 2, and the write pointer + entries x half the capacity (wrapped) when the trigger arrives in mode 1 with the buffer already running. diag_dm1Buffer_circularFill copies it at entry and stops filling when the write pointer data_collector_end_address reaches it, then sets fill phase 3. Written 6 times (stw), read once (lwz). Not a DM1 buffer.

Fill phase of the data collector ring buffer (no e2m record at this address): 0 idle or not started (cm848_phase_groupB_calculation sets it while the collector is disabled - governor_fault_status_flags bit 0x100 clear - and in phase 3 once the trigger is cleared; hpcr_exception_process, the collector reset, sets it too), 1 recording before the trigger (circular fill with no stop address), 2 recording after the trigger up to data_collector_fill_stop_address, 3 stopped (the post-trigger fill ended, or the buffer filled in stop mode 3 and diag_dm1Buffer_circularFill set data_collector_status 2). Dword (stw / lwz). Not a DM1 state.

Set to 1 once the data collector ring buffer holds a byte at the write pointer (data_collector_end_address), 0 while the buffer is empty (no e2m record at this address): diag_dm1Buffer_circularFill stores the first byte of an empty buffer at the write pointer itself and sets this word to 1, every later byte goes one position further (pointer + 1, wrapped from data_collector_buffer_end_address to the buffer start); cm848_phase_groupB_calculation clears it whenever it restarts the buffer (write pointer = read pointer = buffer start) and j1939_dm1_diagnosticMessage_send clears it when the read pointer data_collector_start_address has reached the write pointer, i.e. the whole buffer was sent. 0 / 1, word (sth / lhz). Not a DM1 buffer slot.

Countdown of the data collector sampling interval (no e2m record at this address; the interval is e2m 003A +6 Collector_Multiple, 'Value indicating 20 msec multiple for data collection', data_collector_multiple_cal): cm848_phase_groupB_calculation counts it down once per pass while it is not 0 and skips the sample (it only calls j1939_dm1_diagnosticMessage_send); when it is 0 it reloads data_collector_multiple_cal - 1 (when that is not 0), reads the trigger input line and fills the buffer. So one sample is taken every data_collector_multiple_cal passes. Word (lhz / sth). Not a DM1 protection warning repeat interval.

Number of address entries of the data collector table (data_collector_address_table_cal, e2m 003B Collector_Table; no e2m record at this address): cm848_phase_groupB_calculation counts the non-zero entries (up to the 32 the table holds) when it starts the buffer; one sample is one byte read from each entry, so diag_dm1Buffer_circularFill stops a sample after this many entries, 0x8000 / this = data_collector_sample_capacity, and j1939_dm1_diagnosticMessage_send rounds its 0x20 byte message limit down to a whole number of samples with it. hpcr_exception_process (the collector reset) clears it, and so does cm848_phase_groupB_calculation in phase 3 when the stop mode is not 3. Word (lhz / sth). Not a DM1 fault entry count.

Capacity of the data collector ring buffer in samples, one sample being one byte per table entry (no e2m record at this address): cm848_phase_groupB_calculation sets it to 0x8000 / data_collector_table_entry_count when it starts the buffer; the bytes actually used are entries x this (DAT_003fbcb4), the leftover 0x8000 - entries x this bytes stay unused, so data_collector_buffer_end_address = buffer start + 0x7fff - leftover, and the post-trigger fill of stop mode 1 is half a buffer (entries x (this >> 1) bytes). Word (sth / lhz). Not a bytes per DM1 fault slot.

Memory of the data collector trigger input line from the previous sample (no e2m record at this address): cm848_phase_groupB_calculation reads the line (data_collector_trigger_input_line_cal, e2m Data_Collector_Trigger_Map) with cm848_readDiscreteInputLine each sample; a low line clears this word, an active line sets the trigger data_collector_trigger_active_cal and, when this word is still 0, adds 1 to data_collector_trigger_count_cal (e2m Data_Collector_Trigger_Count) and sets this word to 1, so each activation of the line is counted once. 0 / 1, word (lhz / sth). Not a DM1 protection warning latch.

Table lookup result of the EGR orifice temperature lead time constant (e2m 19CA +A INM_EGRT_Lead_Time_Constant 'Current active EGR orifice temperature lead time constant', SEC at 0.01 per count; the active value is egr_orifice_temperature_lead_time_constant; no e2m record at this address): sensor_throttleTrim_ema_faultProcess interpolates it every pass from egr_mass_flow_delayed_filtered (lookupTableInterpolation over the ROM tables WORD_ARRAY_00406778 / WORD_ARRAY_0040678c) and copies it into egr_orifice_temperature_lead_time_constant unless sensor channel 108 has a fault, air_handling_compensation_and_diagnostic_bypass_cal is set or algorithm_enable_flags_20_cal bit 0x8000 is clear (then that constant is 0). cm848_initialization_step_14 also points the coefficient of the EMA filter record at 0x3fbd00 (ema_filter_state_t_003fbd00) at it. Written once (sth). 500 in the dump = 5.0 s, while the active egr_orifice_temperature_lead_time_constant reads 0 there (algorithm_enable_flags_20_cal bit 0x8000 is clear in this calibration). Not a throttle trim predictor.

Divisor that turns the transmission output shaft speed into vehicle speed, for the low rear axle ratio (no e2m record at this address): cm848_computeProtectionTrimDivisors stores rear_axle_ratio_low_cal (e2m 1180 +6 Rear_Axle_Ratio_Low, 1/128 per count) x protection_timing_period_cal (e2m 132C +0 Tire_Size, 'NUMBER OF TIRE REVOLUTIONS PER MILE') here, i.e. output shaft revolutions per mile x 128. cm848_calculateVehicleSpeedFromOutputShaft, on the J1939 automatic drivetrain, divides output_shaft_speed_current (1/8 rpm) x 0x3c000 (60 x 4096) by it to get vehicle_speed_unfiltered (1/256 mph; the divisor carries the 1/128 scale of the axle ratio) when two_speed_axle_enable_cal is 0 or switch 31 is clear; with a two-speed axle and switch 31 set it divides by output_shaft_to_vehicle_speed_divisor_high_axle_ratio. Dword (lwz / stw). 113703 in the dump = 453 x 251 (rear_axle_ratio_low_cal x protection_timing_period_cal; the 251 is below the e2m Tire_Size range 300-725). Not a fuel trim or protection divisor.

Divisor that turns the transmission output shaft speed into vehicle speed, for the high (second) rear axle ratio (no e2m record at this address): cm848_computeProtectionTrimDivisors stores rear_axle_ratio_high_cal (e2m 1180 +C Rear_Axle_Ratio_High, 1/128 per count) x protection_timing_period_cal (e2m 132C +0 Tire_Size, tire revolutions per mile) here, i.e. output shaft revolutions per mile x 128. cm848_calculateVehicleSpeedFromOutputShaft divides output_shaft_speed_current x 0x3c000 by it into vehicle_speed_unfiltered when two_speed_axle_enable_cal is set and switch 31 is set (the second axle ratio is selected); otherwise it uses output_shaft_to_vehicle_speed_divisor_low_axle_ratio. Dword (lwz / stw). 113703 in the dump = 453 x 251 (rear_axle_ratio_high_cal x protection_timing_period_cal). ROM-to-RAM window outside the EEPROM mirror, so no _cal. Not a fuel trim or protection divisor.

Lowest coolant temperature (sensor_readings_t.coolant_temp, 1/64 degree F per count) seen by the coolant temperature sensor performance monitor (no e2m record at this address): cm848_checkCoolantTemperatureSensorPerformance, the P0116 coolant temperature rationality monitor (fault 401 -> ROM 0x5985a slot table -> obd_dtc_code_table), loads it with the soak snapshot protection_group29_coolant_temp_snapshot when it starts watching (engine running after the snapshot) and lowers it whenever the coolant reads lower; the span to coolant_temperature_sensor_performance_temperature_maximum (cssc_coolant_temp_span) must reach the ROM constant DAT_000642d6 for the monitor to pass. Signed word (sth / lha).

Highest coolant temperature (sensor_readings_t.coolant_temp, 1/64 degree F per count) seen by the coolant temperature sensor performance monitor (no e2m record at this address): cm848_checkCoolantTemperatureSensorPerformance (P0116, fault 401) loads it with the soak snapshot protection_group29_coolant_temp_snapshot when it starts watching and raises it whenever the coolant reads higher; cssc_coolant_temp_span = this - coolant_temperature_sensor_performance_temperature_minimum, and a span at or above the ROM constant DAT_000642d6 clears fault 401 (the coolant rose enough). Signed word (sth / lha).

One-shot guard of the coolant temperature sensor performance monitor (no e2m record at this address): cm848_checkCoolantTemperatureSensorPerformance (P0116, fault 401) sets it to 1 in the first pass after its startup timer reaches 0 and only in that pass tests whether any intake manifold temperature sensor fault (faults 19 / 20 / 354 = P0113 / P0112 / P0111) or battery temperature sensor fault (faults 353 / 379 / 380 = P0514 / P0517 / P0516; ROM 0x5985a slot table -> obd_dtc_code_table) is set - if so the run is abandoned (monitor state 6, readiness bit cleared). The temperature snapshot is taken later, after coolant_temperature_sensor_performance_snapshot_dwell_count has counted up. cm848_initialization_group22_state clears it to 0. Byte (lbz / stb). Not a snapshot flag.

Set to 1 when the soak conditions of the coolant temperature sensor performance test (P0116, fault 401) are met (no e2m record at this address): at its temperature snapshot cm848_checkCoolantTemperatureSensorPerformance takes the intake manifold and battery temperatures and, when the intake manifold temperature is less than the ROM constant DAT_000642de above the battery temperature and the engine-off time is long enough (coolant_temperature_check_minimum_engine_off_time), sets this byte to 1; at the end of the watching window the monitor sets the fault only when it is 1 (else it abandons the run, state 6). cm848_initialization_group22_state clears it to 0. Byte (stb / lbz), 0 / 1. Not a protection group 29 flag.

Dwell counter of the coolant temperature sensor performance monitor before its temperature snapshot (no e2m record at this address): cm848_checkCoolantTemperatureSensorPerformance (P0116, fault 401) adds 1 per pass, after the one-shot sensor precheck coolant_temperature_sensor_performance_precheck_done_flag, until it reaches the ROM constant DAT_000642e0, and only then takes the snapshot of the coolant, battery and intake manifold temperatures and runs the soak tests. cm848_initialization_group22_state clears it to 0. Word (lhz / sth).

Byte 5 of the 80-bit logical output request array at 0x40c080 (requests 40-47; cm848_setLogicalOutputRequest sets bit n & 7 of byte n >> 3), the same layout as logical_output_request_bits_48_to_55: bit 0x08 = request 43 and bit 0x10 = request 44, the two intake air heater (grid heater) relays (cm848_setLogicalOutputRequest(0x2b / 0x2c, 0) and cm848_clearLogicalOutputRequest in the intake air heater code). Read with lbz by cm848_updateIntakeAirHeaterRunupPhase (the run-up elapsed ticks count only while both bits are set), cm848_mainLoopMonitor (a set bit re-issues its request with cm848_clearLogicalOutputAndDriveLine / cm848_setLogicalOutputRequest) and diagnosticMainStateProcessor (system_switch_status_2 bits 2 / 3); written only through cm848_setLogicalOutputRequest. No e2m record at this address.

e2m 0032 +4 Buffer_End [HEX] 'Physical RAM address of the end of the data collector buffer' (4 bytes; 0 in the dump, the collector is idle): the last usable byte of the data collector ring buffer. cm848_phase_groupB_calculation sets it to the buffer start (diag_dm1_buffer_start_ptr, e2m 0031 Buffer_Start, storage from 0x40c28a) + 0x7fff - the unused remainder of the 0x8000 byte buffer (data_collector_sample_capacity x table entries bytes are used) when it starts the buffer; diag_dm1Buffer_circularFill wraps the write pointer data_collector_end_address and the read pointer data_collector_start_address back to the buffer start once they pass it, and j1939_dm1_diagnosticMessage_send wraps its read position the same way. Not a DM1 buffer.

e2m 104A +4 [APAPST] Alpha_State (UNITLESS, 0-5): 'Indicate the source (base, user, altitude, epf, slave, esp) of alpha'. The source hpcr_calculateFuelTrimOutput picked for combustion_alpha_input in its last pass: 0 base (alpha_base), 1 user (fuel_blend_coefficient_startup_cal, governor_feature_flags bit 0), 2 altitude (altitude_derate_alpha, when cm848_checkPressureFuelState is true), 3 epf, the engine protection fault derate (engine_protection_alpha), 4 slave (master_slave_override_enable_flag set: governor_startup_fuel_blend_coeff), 5 esp (governor_feature_config_flags bit 0x8000 with governor_startup_threshold = 0x4000, e2m ESP_Tau: fuel_blend_coefficient_run_cal). Written by 6 sth, no reader. 0 in the dump. Not a governor start-up state.

e2m 104A +12 [APAAPRSS] Alpha_Low_Ambient_Air_Pressure (UNITLESS): 'Alpha based only on ambient air pressure logic'. The result of the ambient air pressure condition of the alpha ramp: cm848_checkPressureHysteresis returns 1 while barometric_pressure_reference is below alpha_lock_on_barometric_pressure (e2m Alpha_Lock_On_Air_Pressure), 0 once it is above alpha_lock_off_barometric_pressure, and otherwise this word again (the hysteresis memory, read signed with lha); timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator stores it when governor_fault_status_flags bit 0x8000 is set and ORs it into the condition that ramps alpha_base toward 1. 0 in the dump. A sibling result is alpha_fuel_rate_result (e2m +8 Alpha_Fuel_Rate).

e2m 104A +16 [APLSTR] Alpha_LSG_Timer (SEC, 0.2 per count, 0-900): 'Trace the time since fueling state has left LSG state'. cm848_checkPressureFuelDelayA reloads it with low_speed_governor_alpha_timeout (e2m LSG_Alpha_Timeout) while alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag is 1 and counts it down (cold_start_timer_a_active_flag) once per alpha execution afterwards; when it reaches 0 the low speed governor alpha condition turns 1; hpcr_calculateFuelTrimOutput reloads it while engine_state is STOPPED, CRANKING or JUMP_START. 1550 in the dump = 310 s. Not a cold start timer.

e2m 104A +18 [APAFTR] Alpha_AFC_Timer (SEC, 0.2 per count, 0-900): 'Trace the time since fueling state is not AFC or LSG.'. cm848_checkPressureFuelDelayB reloads it with air_fuel_control_alpha_timeout (e2m AFC_Alpha_Timeout) while alpha_air_fuel_control_state_detected_flag or alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag is 1 and counts it down (cold_start_timer_b_active_flag) once per alpha execution afterwards; when it reaches 0 the air fuel control alpha condition turns 1; hpcr_calculateFuelTrimOutput reloads it while engine_state is STOPPED, CRANKING or JUMP_START. 1750 in the dump = 350 s. Not a cold start timer.

EEPROM 0x490 - e2m 1185 +4 Cruise_Top_Droop_Width 'TOP DROOP WIDTH FOR CRUISE CONTROL.' (MPH, 1/256 mph; 0 in the dump): the speed width of the upper droop line of the cruise governor: governorCruiseStateMachine turns it into cruise_ramp_rate_b_computed (governor_cruise_rampRate_calc on cruise_fuel_demand_ramp_ceiling - this width with rear_axle_ratio_low_cal, then governor_cruise_tableLimit_calc) and, with rear_axle_ratio_high_cal, into DAT_003fcff2; drivetrain_type DRIVETRAIN_MANUAL_VSS copies the first into cruise_ramp_rate_b_working (e2m 1187 +1A Cruise_Top_Droop_Gain). The road speed governor twin is road_speed_governor_top_droop_width_cal (e2m 1185 +8) and the lower line is cruise_bottom_droop_width_cal (+2). EEPROM mirror, so _cal. Not a fuel demand threshold.

EEPROM 0x170a (mirror) - e2m 11C1 +0 [JC17TMCU] J1708_Link_Fault_Timeout_Count (CNTS, 0-1000): 'Current number of J1708 (J1922) time-outs since powerdown or fault set'. cm848_processGovernorModeTransition adds 1 per expired TSC1 / retarder request timer while j1939_tsc1_override_state.etc1_active_state is not 1 (the J1939 path, state 1, counts in the twin j1939_link_fault_timeout_count_cal; torqueControlModeHandler, the J1939 TSC1 receive handler, is the only writer of that state) and the count is below j1939_link_fault_timeout_count_limit - 1 (e2m Jcomm_Link_Fault_Timeout_Limit); at the limit it sets fault_detected_bits_96_to_111 bit 0x4000 (fault 110; slot 170 of ROM 0x5985a, no OBD code) and returns to 0. The J1708 reading rests on the record and on this twin (medium confidence). 0 in the dump. Word (lhz / sth). EEPROM mirror, so _cal.

e2m 165C +6 Pressure_Check_Delay_Time (SEC, 0.005 per count, 0-327.675): 'Delay time since last shutdown before running pressure check algorithm'. cm848_processSensorDeviationOnKeyoff (runs only with algorithm_enable_flags_6_cal bit 0x20 set and sensor_deviation_check_pending_flag 1) adds 1 to cold_start_deviation_delay_timer per pass while engine_state is STOPPED and, once the timer exceeds this word, runs the pressure sensor agreement check cm848_checkSensorDeviationFlags (barometric pressure against the two other pressure readings, with the tolerances barometric_pressure_sensor_tolerance / boost_pressure_sensor_tolerance / oil_pressure_sensor_tolerance) and clears the pending flag; the timer restarts at 0 whenever the engine is not stopped. 400 in the dump = 2.0 s. ROM-copied constant in RAM, so no _cal.

e2m 16A2 +26 TGC_COT_Deriv_Term (UNITLESS, 1/32 per count, signed, -800..800): 'COT limiter derivative term'. The derivative term of the compressor outlet temperature limiter of the wastegate duty controller: cm848_calculateWastegateDutyRequest sets it, on every second pass (governor_first_iteration_flag alternates), to (compressor_outlet_temperature - its previous value) x fuel_flow_rate_divisor_cal / 660, clamped to +-0x6400 (+-800), and subtracts it from the temperature error x gain term to form wastegate_duty_compressor_outlet_temperature_derate_error_term (e2m +28 TGC_COT_Drt_Error). The turbocharger speed limiter's derivative term is governor_pid_adjustment_output (e2m +22 TGC_Turbo_Deriv_Term). Signed word (sth / lha). 1 in the dump. Not an rpm correction.

e2m 8194 +4 Cam_Crank_Mismatch_Threshold (UNITLESS, 2 bytes, 0-255): 'value of cam-crank mismatch persistence counter which sets error'.
